text:
elena: Quick ask — 2hr train trip tonight. Looking for a micro-binge: two short things (episodes/short films) + one ~45–60min album to ride with. Cozy but a little strange, nothing too heavy. recs?
samir: Love this. Try: 1) 'World of Tomorrow' (Don Hertzfeldt) — ~17m, weirdly sweet. 2) an episode of 'Midnight Gospel' (any) — trippy but short-ish. Album: Sufjan Stevens 'Carrie & Lowell' for the quiet vibes.
tess: Oh yes to World of Tomorrow. Also consider 'Night on Earth' (one episode, the short doc ep) if you want real cities-in-atmosphere. Album: Julia Holter — lots of tiny details for a train.
elena: @tess @samir these sound nice. I wanted something that doesn't demand full focus (I might nap) but still feels like a little narrative capsule.
ben: For cozy+weird TV ep that’s very chill: 'Ramy' S1 ep 1 is ~30m and oddly comforting. For a film short: 'The Lunch Date' (chek) — much older but a nice short. Music: Mild High Club — hazy, mellow.
oda: Tiny shout for animated short: 'The Lost Thing' — warm and strange, ~15m. Pair with 'Nick Drake' droney acoustic if you want melancholic.
maria: Quick poll — do you want primarily: A) comedic/absurd B) meditative/ambient C) nostalgic/folk ? Reply with A/B/C.
elena: leaning B but open to a touch of C.
samir: B :thumbsup:
tess: B
ben: C (throwing a vote for Nick Drake)
oda: B
maria: Looks like B wins. Final two-item stack suggestion: 'World of Tomorrow' + 'The Lost Thing' then album 'Carrie & Lowell' or Julia Holter depending on sleepiness. Enjoy the ride! :train: :headphones:
elena: Perfect — thank you all. Will report back whether the train turned into a mini-film festival or a nap. :popcorn: :zzz:
